fills.researcher_notes: The famous 626.76亿元 figure is PROJECT-WIDE and must not be pasted into this pipeline row's segment cost. chinanews/Xinhua states it explicitly: the 626.76亿元 '具体包括普光气田勘探开发、酸性气体处理以及从四川达州到上海途径8省市的长输管线' — i.e. upstream gas-field development + the acid-gas purification plant + the pipeline. The CAE paper by 马永生 and the nea.gov.cn notice repeat the same aggregate. The only pipeline-only money figures found are balance-sheet, not construction cost: PwC's pro-forma for 中石化川气东送天然气管道有限公司 (via 澎湃 1578871) gives 资产总额 196.33亿元 / 净资产 18.35亿元 at 2016-06-30, and the 增压工程一期 upgrade cost 15亿元 (china5e) — neither is this trunk's build cost. Searched for a pipeline-only figure in Sinopec annual reports, the 2016 引资 announcement, NDRC 核准 documents and provincial EIA texts; none isolates the pipeline.
